description.narrative: IFCs investment is up to 60 million in bond(s) to be issued by Titan Global Finance UK PLC, a subsidiary of Titan SA (Titan or the Company). The Project comprises financing of Titans investment program in Albania, Bulgaria, Kosovo, North Macedonia and Serbia (the Project Countries), including energy-efficiency solutions, low-CO2 cement alternatives, fly ash processing and utilization, and increased use of alternative fuels.

The most significant expected Project-level development outcomes are: (i) environmental effects via greenhouse gases reduction through increased use of AF, supplementary cementitious materials and energy efficiency projects, and (ii) economywide effects through value creation by advancing circular economy principles and increasing productivity through improvement in supply chain management. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will address critical sustainability challenges and carbon reduction objections.
